sentences.pt: Dona Lúcia tem dois netos gêmeos, Lucas e Gabriel.
sentences.en: Mrs. Lúcia has two twin grandsons, Lucas and Gabriel.

sentences.pt: Eles têm dezesseis anos e moram em Salvador.
sentences.en: They are sixteen years old and live in Salvador.

sentences.pt: Os dois são altos e magros, com cabelo escuro e liso.
sentences.en: Both are tall and thin, with dark, straight hair.

sentences.pt: Os olhos deles são grandes e marrons.
sentences.en: Their eyes are big and brown.

sentences.pt: Muitas pessoas acham os meninos iguais.
sentences.en: Many people think the boys are the same.

sentences.pt: Mas Dona Lúcia diz: "Eles são parecidos, mas muito diferentes!"
sentences.en: But Mrs. Lúcia says: "They're alike, but very different!"

sentences.pt: Lucas é calmo e silencioso.
sentences.en: Lucas is calm and quiet.

sentences.pt: Ele gosta de ler romances e desenhar no quarto.
sentences.en: He likes to read novels and draw in his room.

sentences.pt: O quarto dele está sempre limpo e arrumado.
sentences.en: His room is always clean and tidy.

sentences.pt: Gabriel é barulhento e muito engraçado.
sentences.en: Gabriel is noisy and very funny.

sentences.pt: Ele adora futebol e tem muitos amigos na escola.
sentences.en: He loves soccer and has many friends at school.

sentences.pt: O quarto de Gabriel está sempre sujo e cheio de roupas e sapatos.
sentences.en: Gabriel's room is always dirty and full of clothes and shoes.

sentences.pt: Na escola, Lucas tira notas altas em matemática, e Gabriel prefere as aulas de esporte.
sentences.en: At school, Lucas gets high grades in math, and Gabriel prefers sports classes.

sentences.pt: Lucas usa camisas brancas e simples.
sentences.en: Lucas wears simple white shirts.

sentences.pt: Gabriel prefere camisas coloridas, amarelas ou vermelhas.
sentences.en: Gabriel prefers colorful shirts, yellow or red.

sentences.pt: No domingo, os gêmeos visitaram a avó.
sentences.en: On Sunday, the twins visited their grandmother.

sentences.pt: Ela fez um bolo enorme de chocolate.
sentences.en: She made a huge chocolate cake.

sentences.pt: Gabriel comeu três fatias, e Lucas comeu só uma.
sentences.en: Gabriel ate three slices, and Lucas ate only one.

sentences.pt: "Vocês são tão diferentes!", disse a avó, rindo.
sentences.en: "You're so different!" said their grandmother, laughing.

sentences.pt: "Mas os dois são lindos e inteligentes", ela falou, orgulhosa.
sentences.en: "But both of you are handsome and smart," she said, proud.

questions.q: Como é o cabelo dos gêmeos?
questions.qEn: What is the twins' hair like?

questions.q: Quantas fatias de bolo Gabriel comeu?
questions.qEn: How many slices of cake did Gabriel eat?

sentences.pt: Mariana conseguiu um emprego novo no Rio e precisa alugar um apartamento.
sentences.en: Mariana got a new job in Rio and needs to rent an apartment.

sentences.pt: No sábado, ela visitou dois apartamentos com a amiga Luíza.
sentences.en: On Saturday, she visited two apartments with her friend Luíza.

sentences.pt: O primeiro apartamento ficava em Copacabana, perto da praia.
sentences.en: The first apartment was in Copacabana, near the beach.

sentences.pt: Era antigo, mas muito bonito.
sentences.en: It was old, but very pretty.

sentences.pt: A sala era larga e clara, com duas janelas enormes.
sentences.en: The living room was wide and bright, with two huge windows.

sentences.pt: O quarto era confortável, mas o banheiro era pequeno e estreito.
sentences.en: The bedroom was comfortable, but the bathroom was small and narrow.

sentences.pt: A rua também era muito barulhenta, com carros e ônibus o dia todo.
sentences.en: The street was also very noisy, with cars and buses all day.

sentences.pt: E o preço era alto: três mil reais por mês.
sentences.en: And the price was high: three thousand reais a month.

sentences.pt: O segundo apartamento ficava num bairro longe do centro.
sentences.en: The second apartment was in a neighborhood far from downtown.

sentences.pt: O prédio era moderno e tinha um jardim com árvores.
sentences.en: The building was modern and had a garden with trees.

sentences.pt: O apartamento era pequeno, mas limpo e silencioso.
sentences.en: The apartment was small, but clean and quiet.

sentences.pt: A cozinha era nova e tinha uma geladeira grande.
sentences.en: The kitchen was new and had a big refrigerator.

sentences.pt: O preço era mais barato: dois mil reais.
sentences.en: The price was cheaper: two thousand reais.

sentences.pt: "Qual você prefere?", perguntou Luíza.
sentences.en: "Which one do you prefer?" asked Luíza.

sentences.pt: Mariana pensou um pouco.
sentences.en: Mariana thought for a bit.

sentences.pt: "O primeiro é lindo, mas é caro e barulhento", ela disse.
sentences.en: "The first one is beautiful, but it's expensive and noisy," she said.

sentences.pt: "O segundo é simples, mas é quieto e confortável."
sentences.en: "The second one is simple, but it's quiet and comfortable."

sentences.pt: No fim, ela escolheu o segundo apartamento.
sentences.en: In the end, she chose the second apartment.

sentences.pt: Na segunda-feira, ela assinou o contrato, muito feliz.
sentences.en: On Monday, she signed the contract, very happy.

questions.q: Como era a rua do primeiro apartamento?
questions.qEn: What was the street of the first apartment like?
